prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape hero illustration for the Build & CI category page of the Osixia open-source documentation.
Primary request: a charming miniature automated railway dispatch station as a metaphor for continuous integration. A cheerful fox railway dispatcher in a navy conductor cap stands beside a small wooden signal control kiosk, guiding a little freight train carrying three bright orange corrugated shipping containers. The railway traces a broad gentle curve across a neat pale stone landscaped base. One small glazed inspection shelter straddles the track, with a green status light above it; the train has just passed inspection and continues toward a raised green departure signal with a clear white check mark. The fox is coordinating the automated journey, not assembling anything.
Style/medium: premium polished toy-like 3D cartoon diorama, friendly rounded animal with expressive glossy eyes, soft detailed orange fox fur, tactile warm wood, clean miniature orange shipping-container ribs with silver metal corner fittings, segmented lush green foliage. Match the visual family of bright orange containers, adorable animals and lush green plants used in the Osixia documentation. Rich crafted materials, sunny soft studio illumination, gentle shadows and an inviting playful mood.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, complete self-contained diorama visible, readable and uncluttered at documentation width, three-quarter view with plenty of separation between fox, train and inspection shelter. Seamless warm white studio background, smooth pale stone ground, a few green plants at the edges. The train and curving railway are the main visual identity.
Text (verbatim): one tasteful navy sign on the kiosk with warm wooden trim reading exactly "Build & CI" in large white raised letters. No other text or tiny pseudo-text.
Constraints: Create a clearly original scene distinct from an indoor builder's workshop. No beaver, construction helmet, workbench, pegboard, tools, conveyor belt, assembly line, dagger, or dagger-build text. No Kubernetes emblem, islands, ocean, or technical flowchart. No watermark, photorealism, flat vector style, or excessive clutter. The metaphor is a coordinated automated build-and-check journey shown as railway dispatch.
